blocks.content: Course: Python Numpy for Data Science
This course assumes you have a basic understanding of Python fundamentals such as variables, arrays, if else, data types, etc.
If you're unsure about any of these concepts or simply need a refresher, you can take the the Python Basics Course first.
Since Python Lists are essential for working with NumPy, it's important to have a firm grasp on it. To ensure you're ready, we'll revise Python Lists in the next chapter before diving into NumPy.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
